# Lucie Creatives

> Premier video editing and web development agency specializing in cinematic video editing, high-performance web development, graphic design, and branding.

## Main Pages

### [Home](https://luciecreatives.in/)
Lucie Creatives is a premier video editing and web development agency serving ambitious brands worldwide with cinematic video editing, high-performance web development, graphic design, and branding.

### [Video Editing](https://luciecreatives.in/video-editing)
Short-form reels, kinetic typography, DaVinci Resolve color grading, and cinematic commercial video editing engineered for high audience retention.

### [Graphic Design](https://luciecreatives.in/graphic-design)
Monolithic brand identity systems, product packaging architecture, high-converting social media creatives, and out-of-home (OOH) billboard design.

### [Web Development](https://luciecreatives.in/web-development)
Custom website development, responsive website design, sub-second Next.js and React web applications, e-commerce platforms, and SEO-optimized digital systems.

### [Work / Portfolio](https://luciecreatives.in/#work)
Selected commercial client projects and case studies across luxury real estate, architecture, hospitality, consumer goods, and digital platforms.

### [About](https://luciecreatives.in/about)
Agency leadership, culture, and conviction. We engineer unfair cultural advantages for ambitious brands through cinematic storytelling and sub-second digital craft.

### [Careers](https://luciecreatives.in/careers)
Career openings at Lucie Creatives for talented Video Editors and Graphic Designers looking to craft high-retention brand media and monolithic visual identities.

### [Contact](https://luciecreatives.in/contact)
Schedule a project discovery call with Lucie Creatives leadership to discuss web development, graphic design, video editing, or branding.
